Question: i saw a big bottle containing of fresh dates in my dream....so wat does that signifies??????? Answer ID: 11684 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 697/415=H/1430) It is nice dream, it signifies that your good deeds are granted acceptance by Allah and in-shaAllah you will get its full advantage in the hereafter, but more firmness in sincerity is required. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
